description: This file defines the interface CompatTabListener, which declares callback methods for tab selection events within an Android application, serving as a compatibility layer referencing the Android ActionBar.TabListener.

classes.name: CompatTabListener
classes.description: An interface providing callback methods for tab interaction events (selection, unselection, reselection) within a tabbed UI, with references to Android's native TabListener.

methods.name: onTabSelected
methods.description: Callback invoked when a tab has been selected.

methods.name: onTabUnselected
methods.description: Callback invoked when a tab has been unselected.

methods.name: onTabReselected
methods.description: Callback invoked when a tab has been reselected.
